# @fourscore/sdr 1.1.0

Browser-native KiwiSDR and OpenWebRX client, vendored from the npm package
`@fourscore/sdr@1.1.0` (MIT). Relative imports were given explicit `.js`
extensions so Node's ESM loader can run the app's tests; no behaviour changed.

Upstream: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fourscore/sdr
Licence: MIT.
